description: net-forge #550 follow-up: entity spawns the RotN 3.3.4 test server sent during BC probe attempt 3 (GO G-BC-PROBE-3-20261121; harness-ops captures/raw/bc-probe-3-20261121/capture.jsonl, git-ignored).
